scope: Actual raw whole-pool before/after discovery probes, not managed exclusion/adoption tests or image tests. All 24 general query texts and exposed new source en/ko, conditions/effects/application contracts reviewed. No claim of manual judgment for every other control occurrence.

boundary_limit: 34/40 boundary queries expose new sources, including near-confusion alternatives. Full source and requester exclusions still decide. Raw probes are not the managed negative firewall.
nonvisual_limit: 11/16 nonvisual queries expose visible proxies. Neither visible signatures, still faces, films, labels nor circuits prove consent, consciousness, infection, genetic identity or sound. Diagnostic records remain outside positive search.
release_qualification: Source closure and development discoverability verified; general precision, native semantic qualification, causal image improvement and user acceptance are not established.
